mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_name, type_id, price, description, create_time, update_time, img_url, is_deleted, status, publish_start, publish_end, seller_id,postage,ways,donation_percent) VALUES (#{product_name}, #{type_id}, #{price}, #{description}, #{create_time}, #{update_time}, #{img_url}, #{is_deleted}, #{status}, #{publish_start}, #{publish_end}, #{user.id},#{postage},#{ways},#{donation_percent})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.img_url, p.seller_id, p.donation_percent, p.ways, p.postage, u.nickname as user_nickname, u.avatar as user_avatar, u.username , u.location as user_location, u.detail_address as user_detail_address FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT id, product_name, type_id, price, description, create_time, img_url FROM product WHERE product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.img_url, p.is_deleted, p.status, p.publish_start, p.publish_end, u.id AS seller_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE p.type_id = #{typeId}

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.img_url, p.is_deleted, p.status, p.publish_start, p.publish_end, u.id AS seller_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.update_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.img_url, p.is_deleted, p.status, p.publish_start, p.publish_end, u.id AS seller_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY p.update_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.description, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.img_url, p.is_deleted, p.status, p.publish_start, p.publish_end, u.id AS seller_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON p.seller_id = u.id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND p.status = 'UNPUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM product where status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 21
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET product_name = #{product_name}, price = #{price}, description = #{description}, img_url = #{img_url}, status = #{status}, ways = #{ways}, donation_percent = #{donation_percent}, postage = #{postage}, update_time = #{update_time} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_name, type_id, price, description, create_time, update_time, img_url, is_deleted, status, publish_start, publish_end FROM product
